title: Ethical Tech CoLab Board
summary: A local-first spatial whiteboard for touch displays, classrooms, studios and workshops that runs in the browser and can replay how a session's ideas evolved.

narrative.problem: Classrooms, studios and workshops on touch displays need a shared thinking surface that runs without a server, keeps board content on the device, and can replay how ideas evolved.
narrative.decision: Live boards use a host-ordered star topology over encrypted WebRTC: edits to different objects merge in host order and, for the same object, the latest host-ordered change wins, intentionally avoiding CRDT and account/server complexity.
narrative.tradeoff: Concurrent changes to the same object are resolved by the last host-ordered edit rather than merged, and host traffic grows with both active artists and recipients, so the host needs a desktop or unmetered connection.
narrative.limitation: Seven participants are the validated working size; larger sessions should be benchmarked on their real network first. QR handoff and live boards depend on the public PeerJS signaling service, and VPNs or restrictive networks can block WebRTC.
